verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a cloud sync product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any OneDrive setting, policy, or control for disabling telemetry or diagnostic data collection. Community comments about OneDrive being enabled by default concern turning off the sync service itself, not telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
